markets.definition: The Potassium Sorbate Market covers the production and sale of potassium sorbate (E202), the potassium salt of sorbic acid, in powder, granular and encapsulated forms, used as a preservative in food and beverages, personal care and cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and animal feed.
markets.inclusion: Companies that produce potassium sorbate in their own or joint-venture plants and sell it under their own name, including sorbic acid and sorbate producers and diversified food-ingredient or chemical groups for which potassium sorbate is one of their own product lines.
markets.exclusion: Exclude: Food and beverage, cosmetic or pharmaceutical companies that only use potassium sorbate; formulators that only blend bought-in preservatives; contract packers and repackagers.

markets.definition: The Sorbic Acid Market covers the production and sale of sorbic acid (E200) in powder, granular and other forms, made by synthesis from ketene and crotonaldehyde or other routes, used as a preservative and antimicrobial agent in food and beverages, feed, personal care, pharmaceuticals and industrial applications.
markets.inclusion: Companies that produce sorbic acid in their own or joint-venture plants and sell it under their own name, including producers that also make sorbate salts and diversified chemical groups for which sorbic acid is one of their own product lines.
markets.exclusion: Exclude: Companies that only use sorbic acid in their own finished products; formulators that only blend bought-in preservatives; contract packers and repackagers.

markets.definition: The Caffeine Market covers the production and sale of caffeine as an ingredient: synthetic caffeine and natural caffeine extracted from coffee, tea, guarana and other plant sources (including caffeine recovered from decaffeination), in anhydrous powder, granular and encapsulated forms, used in beverages and energy drinks, food, pharmaceuticals, dietary supplements and personal care.
markets.inclusion: Companies that produce caffeine in their own or joint-venture plants (synthesis, extraction or decaffeination recovery) and sell it under their own name, including diversified pharmaceutical, chemical or botanical-extract groups for which caffeine is one of their own product lines.
markets.exclusion: Exclude: Beverage, energy drink, food, supplement and pharmaceutical companies that only use caffeine in their finished products; coffee and tea brands; formulators that only blend bought-in caffeine; contract packers and repackagers.
